summary: Keeps Judgement of Wisdom on the boss for the raid: every attacker with mana gets 59 mana on half its hits.
rotation: Pre-pull: Seal of Righteousness at -4.5s, Seal of Command at -3s, Seal of Wisdom at -1.5s. Replacing Seal of Command leaves its Echo for the first swing

Judgement of Wisdom at the pull, for the duty. For 40s every attacker with mana gets 59 mana back on half its hits (the paladin too). The paladin's melee hits refresh it, so one cast lasts the fight. Judge it again only if it drops
Hammer of Wrath under 20% boss health, before Consecration
Judgement on cooldown on whichever damage seal is up
Seal of Command whenever no damage seal is up

Twist: with Seal of Command up, switch to Seal of Righteousness in the last 1.5s before a swing, then back to Command before the next. One switch per swing, at any mana. Twist of Light's Echo applies the old seal on the next swing
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Dragonfire Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: The duty costs 14.7 DPS at 180s against the same build without it (934.1 against 948.8, 20,000 iterations, seed 1).

The duty's own Judgement of Wisdom gives the paladin the same mana back as the raid's did, so the cost is the two seals' GCDs and mana and the one judgement that isn't a Judgement of Command or Righteousness.

Seal of Wisdom (rank 3, 200 mana) is up only until the next seal replaces it. Its own 90 mana on a melee hit is assumed to come on half the hits, as Judgement of Wisdom's does: the client says only "a chance".
Takes Pursuit of Justice 2 (movement speed), a must-have talent. It costs nothing here, because it replaced Purifying Power, which does nothing on this boss.
5 DPS ahead of Ret twist at 120s, 4.0 at 180s and 8 at 300s. Ret twist's Precision puts its hit over the 8% cap.
Purifying Power does nothing on the generic boss.
Unverified: Holy Strike's flat bonus is added before its weapon damage percent, as the client data says.
The top Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% of DPS).

Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power per hit with a two-hander, counted once, as its tooltip says (spell 70425). Counted twice, DPS would be 46-51 higher. At the proc spell's 0%, it would be 53-59 lower.
Two-Handed Weapon Specialization boosts Holy seal damage, as in the Era sim. The client says Physical only. Without it, DPS is 11 lower.
No filler explosive, because each 1s cast resets the swing. The Goblin Land Mine and EZ-Thro Dark Bomb cost 4.9 DPS at 180s, and the EZ-Thro Thorium Grenade 5.7.
